title: Warranty Registration Workflow Missing Metadata Exception Rate
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=warranty:registration
| where required_fields_missing=*
| stats sum(required_fields_missing) as missing_fields count as items by product_type
| eval avg_missing=round(missing_fields/items,2)
| where avg_missing>0
| sort - avg_missing
description: Highlights warranty registration workflow records that routinely arrive with required fields missing.
value: Bad metadata is why personal admin trackers become untrustworthy, so exception rate is a useful hygiene metric.
implementation: Count missing required fields during ingest and write the total into `required_fields_missing` for each record.
visualization: Table of product type values by average missing fields per record.
grandmaExplanation: It records where the records behind warranty registration workflow are missing important details and need cleanup.
